audit_log.details: LinkedIn Jobs search blocked intermittently by Cloudflare (403 Forbidden). Initial pages loaded successfully showing 123-153 vacancies; subsequent navigations blocked.

60 job URLs extracted. 17 postings validated against rules. Detail pages accessed for 12 postings. 5 postings have URLs but detail page not accessed (HARMAN, Suntory Sr Field, Essity, Allergan Aesthetics, Tiffany & Co). Cloudflare blocked some detail page navigations during session.
Detail pages accessed for remaining 5 postings: Essity, Allergan Aesthetics, Tiffany & Co., PayJoy, Kellanova.
